instruction: I want enhanced protection for safer browsing. Can you enable the Enhanced Safe Browsing feature in Chrome for me?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Enhanced Safe Browsing in Chrome security settings (chrome://settings/security). The evaluator reads the Default/Preferences file to check if 'safebrowsing.enhanced' is set to true. Similar difficulty - single security setting modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome Enhanced Safe Browsing state from preferences file (safebrowsing.enhanced)
Metric correctly compares boolean enabled status between result and expected
